resources.string: Anomaly01 is a launcher that gives you full visibility into how your phone\'s resources are being used. You decide how much to share.\n\nNo data leaves your device without your explicit permission.
Just an app. View device stats and launch apps. No launcher replacement, no special permissions.
Set Anomaly01 as your default launcher. Full home screen experience with device monitoring.
Full launcher plus storage management and optional ADIN network participation. Requires storage permission.
